March: Book One (2014) is retained as an honorable mention because the historical winners list calls it a special recognition; The Burning Season (1991) is likewise marked honorable mention from a contemporary report. Beloved (1988) is excluded as fiction. The archive repeats the 1995 heading for Jack Bass, whose official detail page and contemporary records identify his award as 1994; the importer corrects that isolated heading error. Historical finalist slates were not published and are not inferred.

awards.description: The Royal Society Science Book Prize recognizes science books written for non-specialist readers.
awards.criteria: Active years represented: 1988-present. Covers winners from 1988 onward and shortlisted books from 2000 onward where listed in the deterministic table.

awards.name: Truman Capote Award for Literary Criticism

awards.name: Wainwright Prize: Conservation Writing
awards.description: Wainwright Prize: Conservation Writing recognizes conservation writing books represented in The Book Prize Index.
awards.criteria: Active years represented: 2020-present. Adult Conservation Writing winners and shortlists for 2020-2025, plus official longlists for 2021-2025. The category was formerly styled Writing on Global Conservation; books retain only their highest status.

awards.name: Wainwright Prize: Nature Writing
awards.description: Wainwright Prize: Nature Writing recognizes nature writing books represented in The Book Prize Index.
awards.criteria: Active years represented: 2014-present. Adult Nature Writing winners and shortlists for 2014-2025, plus official longlists for 2021-2025. Books retain only their highest status.

awards.name: Wellcome Book Prize: Nonfiction
awards.description: Wellcome Book Prize: Nonfiction recognizes nonfiction books represented in The Book Prize Index.
awards.criteria: Active years represented: 2009-2012; 2014-2019. Nonfiction winners and shortlisted works from all ten award editions. Fiction winners and nominees are excluded through an explicit reviewed title set; 2013 was a no-award relaunch year.
